misprints.note: No iota subscript under ω in the print (Afväga).

uncertain.text: Ah, βαβαί. αἰβοῖ. — ἆ. φεῦ. — ἰώ.
uncertain.note: The mark over the interjection α is small and unclear. It reads as breathing plus circumflex (ἆ), but it could be ἇ. The older OCR had ἄ.
Running head, written in print order with page number 11 last and no parenthesis. Other unproofed header strips use a '11) X — Y.' form, so the convention may need to be made the same across pages.
What looks like a ring over the A is the descender from the line above (the iota subscript of ἀπᾴδειν and the tail of ρ in φορά), so the A is plain, not Å.
